recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型顆粒球，核碎成多個不規則小葉（異常過度分葉），下方另一顆中性球核呈雙葉、細胞質淡而顆粒少（假性 Pelger 加低顆粒化）；兩種異常一起出現，指向顆粒球系發育不良。
features: Large granulocyte with abnormal multilobated/hypersegmented nucleus with irregular clumped lobes
Abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Second neutrophil (lower center) with bilobed pseudo-Pelger nucleus and pale hypogranular cytoplasm
Scattered erythroid precursors and a megakaryocytic fragment/platelet clumps at the upper right
RBCs with refractile drying artifact; background with stain precipitate
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large granulocyte with an abnormally multilobated nucleus of irregular, clumped lobes and finely granular cytoplasm. Below it, a neutrophil has a bilobed pseudo-Pelger nucleus and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors and platelet clumps are present at the edge, and red cells show drying artifact. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; correlation with blast count, multilineage dysplasia, and cytogenetics is required to support myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmentation is accompanied by giant metamyelocytes and megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open chromatin, and granulation is preserved.
Growth factor therapy produces toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, and left shift with increased granules rather than hypogranularity.
The inherited anomaly shows uniformly bilobed neutrophils with normal granulation and no giant hypersegmented forms.
